rects.name: settings-tab-bar-glass
rects.why: The sidebar tab bar's Liquid Glass capsule (herdrup 9845ecf HerdrApp.swift 2818-2843), the same rect as the board masks' tab-bar-glass. In Settings the list scrolls under it and the glass refracts it (bent, blurred rows inside the capsule: settings-sidebar-bottom.png in the herdrup-desk evidence directory); CSS cannot draw refraction. herdr-app 380610. The tab icons and labels inside stay compared in the Gram and detail captures, where the glass is over the bare sidebar.
